This Mfa Is Filed U/S.173(1) Of Mv Act, Against The
 Judgment And Award Dt.17.09.2019 Passed In Mvc No.67/2017
 On The File Of The Iii Additional District Judge And Mact,
 Hassan, Dismissing The Claim Petition For Compensation.
 This Appeal Is Coming On For Admission, This Day, The
 Court Delivered The Following:
 -2-
 Nc: 2024:Khc:21031
 Mfa No. 2003 of 2020
 Judgment
The appellant claiming to have sustained accidental injuries filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
The Tribunal dismissed the claim petition stating that there was no evidence to substantiate that the claimant sustained injuries in a road traffic accident.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. The FIR was lodged after five days from the date of accident, and the medical record indicated that there is over writing with regard to registration number of the offending vehicle, and also the date of accident, and the name of the claimant.
4. The Tribunal taking into account the same has rightly dismissed the claim petition.
I do not find any illegality in the impugned award passed by the tribunal.

Sd/-
JUDGE HB,
